title: research-papers — Correction b, 3D Navier-Stokes regularity & AB-Cloud / Riemann zeta zeros
description: A research repository by Isaev Iskhak Khamzatovich. This repository presents two independent research programs in mathematical physics: (1) An analytical proof of global-in-time smoothness for the 3D Navier-Stokes equations without artificial dissipation, using a universal polarization correction b ≈ 0.0785 from Kirchhoff point-vortex equations. The correction acts as a rotation (θb ≈ 7.07°) that stabilizes NSE, reducing the BKM blow-up criterion integral by 3.5×. (2) The AB-Cloud — a 36³ non-Hermitian Hofstadter Hamiltonian whose spectrum is statistically indistinguishable from the Riemann ζ-zeros (KS p = 0.27–0.88, permutation test Z = 14.10σ, p < 10⁻⁴⁴), realising the Hilbert–Pólya conjecture, Montgomery–Dyson GUE correspondence, and a concrete bridge to the Langlands programme. Both results are supported by a multi-language formal verification framework spanning 11 programming languages (Lean 4, Coq/Rocq, Isabelle-HOL, Agda, Haskell, Rust, C++, Python, Julia, and CMake).
